rationale: Describes a modular, multi-threaded, multi-platform log collection solution receiving logs from files and networks without an affirmative AI signal.
evidence_spans:
The NXLog Enterprise Edition is a high-performance multi-platform log collection solution aimed at solving these tasks and doing it with a single tool.

NXLog Enterprise Edition is a modular, multi-threaded, high-performance log collection solution with multi-platform support. It can collect logs from files in various formats, receive logs from the network remotely over UDP, TCP or TLS/SSL .
